messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] write.cross() for BCsFt crosses
parts:
Oops; sorry. This will be an easy fix, but for now, convert the cross type to "f2":

class(mycross)[1] <- "f2"
write.cross(mycross, "csv", filestem="mycross")

karl


On Apr 29, 2013, at 2:16 PM, Ryan McCormick <ryanab...@tamu.edu> wrote:

> Hi all,
>
> I would like to use the write.cross() function for a BCsFt type cross, but it only seems to work for "gary" and "qtlcart" formats. Is this pilot error on my part, or are the other outputs not supported for BCsFt type crosses?
>
> If it's not supported, does anyone have a bit of code that can combine and format the outputs of pull.geno(), pull.pheno(), and pull.map() into the csv/csvr format?
>
> Alternatively, could a BCsFt type cross somehow be converted to an F2 type for compatibility with write.cross()?
>
> Thank you,
> Ryan McCormick
>
